payload.friendly_name: Gate-A read surface: API root, offering, generic artifact routes and links
payload.purpose_context: The charter contract still serves artifacts on one route family per kind and carries no links. ADR-0019 and ADR-0020 D1 settle a root, an offering resource and generic artifact routes with required links; this 0.x change lands them inside the unreleased 0.1.0, together with the fingerprint-declaration fix (#175) and the corrected refusal examples (#176), so core's future generated client can start at the root and follow links.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give the charter API the read surface core adopts at Gate A: an API root, the offering, one generic route family for every artifact kind, and hypermedia links on every answer.

payload.question: Is the Gate-A read surface scope (research note sections 6-7: artifact envelope, writes moved into the generic tree, smallest offering set, #175 fingerprint policy, #46 no effect, inside 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT, kind_not_found, one PR) the confirmed intent?

payload.final_answer: Confirmed as ruled: operator rulings of 2026-10-31 relayed by the orchestrator session (research note section 7); orchestrator instruction: proceed to specify.
